method: Built-in image_gen; original scene illustrations. App runtime only reads local PNG files.

prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original pixel-art illustrated backdrop for a Minecraft FTB Quests chapter map. Create ONE beautiful wide landscape in crisp handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, consistent high quality with a painterly pixel-art fantasy world. Scene: a forgotten arcane observatory with carved rune stones, violet crystal clusters, an eclipse-lit sky and narrow magical library silhouettes at the far edges. Palette: deep indigo, muted violet, antique gold. Keep the central 60 percent broad, dark, quiet, low contrast and low-detail so quest icons and connectors overlaid on the image are easily readable. Put interesting silhouette detail at outer edges and lower corners; no focal object in the center. Atmospheric depth, restrained luminosity, subtly textured pixels. Landscape 3:2 composition. No recognizable existing game assets, no screenshots, no characters, no written text, no UI, no logo, no watermark. Opaque dark background.
